LanguageData.AB_VerboseLoggingTip: Write detailed diagnostic messages to the log. Only useful when hunting a bug.
LanguageData.AB_NotLinkedLine: Not connected to another level yet.
LanguageData.AB_ViewOtherLevelDesc: Jump the camera to the connected stairwell on the other level. You can also press Page Up and Page Down to switch levels.
LanguageData.AB_BasementCreated: The basement level has been opened. It is solid rock, mine it out to expand.
LanguageData.AB_SkyCreated: The sky level has been opened. Build floors above roofed rooms to expand upward.
LanguageData.AB_OnlySurfaceForNow: Must be placed on the surface level.
LanguageData.AB_LevelCap: Level limit reached (one above, one below).
LanguageData.AB_ShowLiveBelow: Show live movement on the level below
LanguageData.AB_ShowLiveBelowTip: Draw pawns, animals, and projectiles from the level below when looking down through open air. Turn off if you want a small performance gain on the sky level.
LanguageData.AB_BelowDimTip: How much the view of the level below is darkened when seen from above.
LanguageData.AB_BelowDepthShiftTip: Shifts the whole view of the level below slightly down-screen so elevated platforms and walls read as raised instead of painted onto the ground. Measured in cells; 0 restores exact alignment.
LanguageData.AB_SlabEdgeTip: Rooftops, sky floors, and landings show a dark side face along edges that border open air, so upper stories read as slabs stacked on the story below. The south face height follows the below view depth offset.
LanguageData.AB_WallRevealTip: The outer ring of rooftop tiles shows a strip of the supporting wall's top along edges that border open air, so the roof reads as resting on the wall line below instead of floating. Covered by anything built on the rim.
LanguageData.AB_WallRevealWidthTip: How much of the outer rooftop tile shows the wall underneath, in cells.
LanguageData.AB_WallFacade: Draw wall faces under slab edges
LanguageData.AB_WallFacadeTip: South-facing slab edges show a sliver of the actual wall underneath in place of the plain dark face, so a wall built on the roof edge and the wall below it read as one continuous tall wall. Follows the below view depth offset.
LanguageData.AB_BelowScaleTip: Pawns, animals, items, plants, and furniture on the level below draw smaller than life size, mimicking the zoom out of looking down a full story. Every object shrinks in place on its own cell, so nothing slides or misaligns. Walls and other connected structures keep their true size.
LanguageData.AB_BelowParallaxTip: The level below drifts slightly against the camera as you pan, mimicking real perspective depth. Purely visual; a stronger depth illusion at the cost of a little roof edge misalignment near the screen edges.
LanguageData.AB_BelowParallaxStrengthTip: How far the level below is displaced at the screen edge, in cells. The on-screen displacement stays constant across zoom levels.
LanguageData.AB_ClimbTimeTip: Multiplies how long every stairs type takes to climb. Ladders are slower and grand staircases faster than normal stairs regardless.
LanguageData.AB_ShowCeilingHint: Show ceiling hints on the surface
LanguageData.AB_ShowCeilingHintTip: Cells under a built sky level floor draw a faint ceiling texture, so you can tell there is a structure overhead while looking at the surface.
LanguageData.AB_StairsCollapsed: A stairwell lost its support and collapsed.
LanguageData.AB_DismountFirst: Dismount before using stairs or elevators.
LanguageData.AB_GoUpDesc: Take the nearest stairs to the level above.
LanguageData.AB_GoDownDesc: Take the nearest stairs to the level below.
LanguageData.AB_NoStairs: no linked stairs on this level
LanguageData.AB_LinkBlocked: The stairwell could not connect. The matching spot on the other level is blocked.
LanguageData.AB_BlockedOnTarget: The matching spot on the other level is blocked.
LanguageData.AB_NoSupportOnTarget: The matching spot on the other level cannot support a stairwell.
LanguageData.AB_CrossLevelWork: Colonists take stairs to work on other levels
LanguageData.AB_CrossLevelWorkTip: When a colonist finds no work on their current level, they check directly linked levels and take the stairs if there is something to do there.
LanguageData.AB_IdleReturnHome: Idle colonists return to the surface
LanguageData.AB_IdleReturnHomeTip: Colonists with nothing to do on any level head back down to the surface instead of roaming the level they worked on.
LanguageData.AB_CrossLevelHaulingTip: When an item's best storage is on another level, haulers carry it through the stairs. Runs after normal hauling on the same level.
LanguageData.AB_CrossLevelNeeds: Colonists cross levels to sleep in their beds
LanguageData.AB_CrossLevelNeedsTip: A tired colonist whose bed is on another level takes the stairs instead of sleeping on the ground.
LanguageData.AB_RemoveLinkDesc: Mark this for removal. A builder will deconstruct it, which also removes the linked end on the other level. Vertical links cannot be damaged, so this is the only way to get rid of them.
LanguageData.AB_ColumnWealthTip: The storyteller counts wealth and pawns on all your levels, not just the surface. Prevents hiding wealth from raid scaling in the basement. Recommended on for honest difficulty.
LanguageData.AB_WorldIntegrationTip: Caravans can include colonists from other levels (they take the stairs to join the gathering), transport pods and shuttles can launch from the sky level, trade beacons on any level sell their goods, and comms consoles work below ground.
LanguageData.AB_CaravanNeedsSurfacePawn: Caravans must form on the surface: include at least one colonist who is on the surface level.
LanguageData.AB_CaravanPawnNoStairs: {0} cannot reach any stairs to the surface and will not join the caravan.
LanguageData.AB_CaravanPawnsDescending: {0} colonist(s) are taking the stairs to join the caravan.
LanguageData.AB_AbandonLevelsWarning: {0} colonist(s) are still on other levels of this colony. Abandoning the settlement destroys every level with it, and they will be lost. Are you sure?
LanguageData.AB_ThreatBasementInfestTip: When an infestation fires at your colony, it has a chance to burrow up into the basement level instead of the surface. Threat size and storyteller pacing are unchanged; only the battlefield moves. Off by default.
LanguageData.AB_ThreatSkyDrops: Drop-pod raids can target the sky level
LanguageData.AB_ThreatSkyDropsTip: When a hostile drop-pod raid fires at your colony, it has a chance to land on your rooftops instead of the surface. Raiders who find nothing to fight up there will take your stairs down. Threat size and storyteller pacing are unchanged. Off by default.
LanguageData.AB_ThreatDivertChanceTip: The chance that an eligible incident is diverted to another level instead of hitting the surface.
LanguageData.AB_ExtendUpDesc: Extend the elevator shaft to the level above, opening it if needed, and place a linked car there.
LanguageData.AB_ExtendDownDesc: Extend the elevator shaft to the level below, opening it if needed, and place a linked car there.
LanguageData.AB_LevelWidgetTip: You can also press Page Up and Page Down.
LanguageData.AB_ShowLevelWidgetTip: Adds view level above and view level below buttons next to the other view toggles in the bottom right.
LanguageData.AB_GridLinkReceiving: Grid link: receiving {0} W from the connected level.
LanguageData.AB_GridLinkSending: Grid link: sending {0} W to the connected level.
LanguageData.AB_GridLinkIdle: Grid link: connected, no flow needed.
LanguageData.AB_CrossLevelPipesTip: When pipes from Dubs Bad Hygiene or a Vanilla Expanded pipe network touch a linked stairwell on both levels, their stored contents flow between the levels. Power conduits connect through stairwells regardless of this setting.
LanguageData.AB_CrossLevelTemperatureTip: Linked stairwells slowly equalize temperature between the rooms they stand in, like a vent between floors. The sky level also follows the surface's outdoor temperature and seasons.
